CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION consultation_private.research_current(ids jsonb)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
 SET lock_timeout TO '3s'
AS $function$DECLARE item jsonb;BEGIN
 IF jsonb_array_length(ids)>0 THEN LOCK TABLE public.research_workbook_versions,public.research_workbook_reviews IN SHARE MODE;END IF;
 FOR item IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(ids) LOOP
  IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.research_workbook_versions w WHERE w.id=(item#>>'{}')::uuid AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.research_workbook_versions newer WHERE newer.workbook_id=w.workbook_id AND newer.version>w.version) AND (SELECT decision FROM public.research_workbook_reviews r WHERE r.version_id=w.id ORDER BY reviewed_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT 1)='approved_internal' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.research_workbook_reviews rejected WHERE rejected.version_id=w.id AND rejected.decision='returned' AND rejected.reviewed_at>=(SELECT max(accepted.reviewed_at) FROM public.research_workbook_reviews accepted WHERE accepted.version_id=w.id AND accepted.decision='approved_internal'))) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'research unavailable or not approved' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
 END LOOP;
END $function$

BEGIN TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL REPEATABLE READ READ ONLY;
SET LOCAL search_path = pg_catalog;
SET LOCAL statement_timeout = '5s';
SET LOCAL lock_timeout = '500ms';
SELECT jsonb_build_object('section','snapshot','rows',jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('id',pg_current_snapshot()::text,'at',clock_timestamp(),'readOnly',current_setting('transaction_read_only'))))::text;
SELECT jsonb_build_object('section','session','rows',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(q)),'[]'::jsonb) FROM (SELECT current_database() AS database_name, current_user AS catalog_reader,
       session_user AS login_role,
       current_setting('server_version_num') AS server_version_num,
       current_setting('server_encoding') AS server_encoding,
       current_setting('transaction_read_only') AS read_only) q))::text;
SELECT jsonb_build_object('section','schemas','rows',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(q)),'[]'::jsonb) FROM (SELECT wanted.name, n.oid IS NOT NULL AS present,
       owner.rolname AS owner, n.nspacl
FROM (VALUES ('auth'),('public'),('consultation_private'),
             ('consultation_ticket_private')) AS wanted(name)
LEFT JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.nspname = wanted.name
LEFT JOIN pg_roles owner ON owner.oid = n.nspowner
ORDER BY wanted.name) q))::text;
SELECT jsonb_build_object('section','relations','rows',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(q)),'[]'::jsonb) FROM (WITH scope(schema_name,table_name) AS (VALUES
 ('auth','users'),
 ('public','consultation_advisors'),('public','consultation_relationships'),
 ('public','consultation_revocations'),('public','consultation_sessions'),
 ('public','consultation_private_notes'),('public','consultation_events'),
 ('public','consultation_publications'),('public','consultation_actions'),
 ('public','consultation_command_receipts'),
 ('public','member_holding_versions'),('public','member_holding_positions'),
 ('public','member_debt_positions'),('public','member_cash_flow_versions'),
 ('public','member_cash_flow_entries'),('public','member_goals_versions'),
 ('consultation_ticket_private','requests'),
 ('consultation_ticket_private','events'),
 ('consultation_ticket_private','receipts'),
 ('consultation_ticket_private','prepared_intents')
)
SELECT s.schema_name, s.table_name, c.oid IS NOT NULL AS present,
 c.relkind, owner.rolname AS owner, c.relrowsecurity, c.relforcerowsecurity,
 c.relacl, c.reltype::regtype::text AS rowtype, t.typacl,
 (SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
   'ordinal',a.attnum,'name',a.attname,
   'type',format_type(a.atttypid,a.atttypmod),'notNull',a.attnotnull,
   'identity',a.attidentity,'generated',a.attgenerated,'columnAcl',a.attacl,
   'default',pg_get_expr(d.adbin,d.adrelid)) ORDER BY a.attnum)
  FROM pg_attribute a LEFT JOIN pg_attrdef d
   ON d.adrelid=a.attrelid AND d.adnum=a.attnum
  WHERE a.attrelid=c.oid AND a.attnum>0 AND NOT a.attisdropped) AS columns,
 (SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',k.conname,'type',k.contype,
   'validated',k.convalidated,'deferrable',k.condeferrable,
   'deferred',k.condeferred,'definition',pg_get_constraintdef(k.oid,false))
   ORDER BY k.conname) FROM pg_constraint k WHERE k.conrelid=c.oid) AS constraints,
 (SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',x.relname,'valid',i.indisvalid,
   'ready',i.indisready,'definition',pg_get_indexdef(i.indexrelid))
   ORDER BY x.relname) FROM pg_index i JOIN pg_class x ON x.oid=i.indexrelid
   WHERE i.indrelid=c.oid) AS indexes,
 (SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',g.tgname,'enabled',g.tgenabled,
   'function',g.tgfoid::regprocedure::text,
   'definition',pg_get_triggerdef(g.oid,false)) ORDER BY g.tgname)
   FROM pg_trigger g WHERE g.tgrelid=c.oid AND NOT g.tgisinternal) AS triggers,
 (SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',p.polname,'command',p.polcmd,
   'permissive',p.polpermissive,
   'roles',ARRAY(SELECT CASE WHEN rid=0 THEN 'PUBLIC'
      ELSE pg_get_userbyid(rid)::text END FROM unnest(p.polroles) AS u(rid)),
   'using',pg_get_expr(p.polqual,p.polrelid),
   'check',pg_get_expr(p.polwithcheck,p.polrelid)) ORDER BY p.polname)
   FROM pg_policy p WHERE p.polrelid=c.oid) AS policies
FROM scope s LEFT JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.nspname=s.schema_name
LEFT JOIN pg_class c ON c.relnamespace=n.oid AND c.relname=s.table_name
LEFT JOIN pg_roles owner ON owner.oid=c.relowner
LEFT JOIN pg_type t ON t.oid=c.reltype
ORDER BY s.schema_name,s.table_name) q))::text;
SELECT jsonb_build_object('section','functions','rows',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(q)),'[]'::jsonb) FROM (SELECT n.nspname AS schema_name, p.proname,
 pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid) AS identity_arguments,
 p.proargnames, p.pronargdefaults,
 pg_get_function_arguments(p.oid) AS arguments_with_defaults,
 pg_get_function_result(p.oid) AS result,
 l.lanname AS language, p.prokind, p.prosecdef, p.provolatile,
 p.proisstrict, p.proleakproof, p.proparallel, p.proretset,
 p.proconfig, owner.rolname AS owner, owner.rolsuper, owner.rolbypassrls,
 p.proacl, p.prosrc,
 CASE WHEN p.prokind='f' THEN pg_get_functiondef(p.oid) END AS definition
FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace
JOIN pg_language l ON l.oid=p.prolang
JOIN pg_roles owner ON owner.oid=p.proowner
WHERE (
 n.nspname IN ('consultation_private','consultation_ticket_private') OR
 (n.nspname='auth' AND p.proname='uid') OR
 (n.nspname='public' AND p.proname IN (
  'load_consultation','command_consultation',
  'load_consultation_ticket_inbox','load_consultation_ticket',
  'lookup_consultation_ticket','command_consultation_ticket',
  'prepare_consultation_ticket_attempt','lookup_consultation_ticket_attempt',
  'load_consultation_ticket_attempts')))
ORDER BY n.nspname,p.proname,identity_arguments) q))::text;
SELECT jsonb_build_object('section','builtins','rows',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(q)),'[]'::jsonb) FROM (SELECT signature, to_regprocedure(signature) IS NOT NULL AS present
FROM (VALUES ('pg_catalog.gen_random_uuid()'),
 ('pg_catalog.sha256(bytea)'),('pg_catalog.convert_to(text,name)'),
 ('pg_catalog.encode(bytea,text)'),('pg_catalog.hashtext(text)'),
 ('pg_catalog.pg_advisory_xact_lock(integer,integer)'),
 ('pg_catalog.clock_timestamp()')) AS wanted(signature)
ORDER BY signature) q))::text;
SELECT jsonb_build_object('section','roles','rows',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(q)),'[]'::jsonb) FROM (WITH RECURSIVE seeds(oid) AS (
 SELECT oid FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname IN
  ('anon','authenticated','service_role',current_user,session_user)
 UNION SELECT p.proowner FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace
 WHERE n.nspname IN ('consultation_private','consultation_ticket_private')
    OR (n.nspname='public' AND p.proname IN
      ('load_consultation','command_consultation',
       'load_consultation_ticket_inbox','load_consultation_ticket',
       'lookup_consultation_ticket','command_consultation_ticket',
       'prepare_consultation_ticket_attempt','lookup_consultation_ticket_attempt',
       'load_consultation_ticket_attempts'))
), reachable(oid) AS (
 SELECT oid FROM seeds UNION
 SELECT m.roleid FROM pg_auth_members m JOIN reachable r ON m.member=r.oid
)
SELECT r.rolname,r.rolsuper,r.rolbypassrls,r.rolinherit,r.rolcanlogin,
 (SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('parent',parent.rolname,
   'adminOption',m.admin_option,
   'inheritOption',to_jsonb(m)->>'inherit_option',
   'setOption',to_jsonb(m)->>'set_option') ORDER BY parent.rolname)
  FROM pg_auth_members m JOIN pg_roles parent ON parent.oid=m.roleid
  WHERE m.member=r.oid) AS memberships
FROM reachable x JOIN pg_roles r ON r.oid=x.oid ORDER BY r.rolname) q))::text;
SELECT jsonb_build_object('section','defaultAcls','rows',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(q)),'[]'::jsonb) FROM (SELECT creator.rolname AS creator, n.nspname AS schema_name,
 d.defaclobjtype, d.defaclacl
FROM pg_default_acl d JOIN pg_roles creator ON creator.oid=d.defaclrole
LEFT JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=d.defaclnamespace
WHERE d.defaclnamespace=0 OR n.nspname IN
 ('public','auth','consultation_private','consultation_ticket_private')
ORDER BY creator.rolname,n.nspname,d.defaclobjtype) q))::text;
SELECT jsonb_build_object('section','functionAcls','rows',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(q)),'[]'::jsonb) FROM (SELECT n.nspname,p.proname,pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid) AS args,
 CASE WHEN a.grantee=0 THEN 'PUBLIC' ELSE pg_get_userbyid(a.grantee)::text END AS grantee,
 pg_get_userbyid(a.grantor) AS grantor,a.privilege_type,a.is_grantable
FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace
CROSS JOIN LATERAL aclexplode(coalesce(p.proacl,acldefault('f',p.proowner))) a
WHERE n.nspname IN ('consultation_private','consultation_ticket_private')
 OR (n.nspname='public' AND p.proname IN
   ('load_consultation','command_consultation',
    'load_consultation_ticket_inbox','load_consultation_ticket',
    'lookup_consultation_ticket','command_consultation_ticket',
    'prepare_consultation_ticket_attempt','lookup_consultation_ticket_attempt',
    'load_consultation_ticket_attempts'))
ORDER BY n.nspname,p.proname,args,grantee) q))::text;
SELECT jsonb_build_object('section','effectivePrivileges','rows',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(q)),'[]'::jsonb) FROM (WITH roles AS (
 SELECT oid,rolname,rolsuper,rolbypassrls FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname IN('anon','authenticated','service_role','postgres')
), tables AS (
 SELECT c.oid,c.relname,c.relowner,c.relrowsecurity,c.relforcerowsecurity,n.nspname
 FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE c.relkind='r' AND
 (n.nspname='consultation_ticket_private' OR (n.nspname='public' AND (c.relname LIKE 'consultation_%' OR c.relname IN('member_holding_versions','member_holding_positions','member_debt_positions','member_cash_flow_versions','member_cash_flow_entries','member_goals_versions'))))
)
SELECT 'table' AS kind,nspname||'.'||relname AS object,rolname AS role,
 jsonb_build_object('select',has_table_privilege(r.oid,t.oid,'SELECT'),'insert',has_table_privilege(r.oid,t.oid,'INSERT'),'update',has_table_privilege(r.oid,t.oid,'UPDATE'),'delete',has_table_privilege(r.oid,t.oid,'DELETE'),'allColumnsSelect',(SELECT bool_and(has_column_privilege(r.oid,t.oid,a.attnum,'SELECT')) FROM pg_attribute a WHERE a.attrelid=t.oid AND a.attnum>0 AND NOT a.attisdropped),'owner',pg_get_userbyid(t.relowner),'rls',t.relrowsecurity,'forced',t.relforcerowsecurity,'roleSuper',r.rolsuper,'roleBypassRls',r.rolbypassrls) AS privileges
 FROM tables t CROSS JOIN roles r
UNION ALL
 SELECT 'function',n.nspname||'.'||p.proname||'('||pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid)||')',r.rolname,
 jsonb_build_object('execute',has_function_privilege(r.oid,p.oid,'EXECUTE'),'schemaUsage',has_schema_privilege(r.oid,n.oid,'USAGE'),'owner',pg_get_userbyid(p.proowner),'securityDefiner',p.prosecdef,'roleSuper',r.rolsuper,'roleBypassRls',r.rolbypassrls)
 FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace CROSS JOIN roles r WHERE p.prokind='f' AND (n.nspname IN('consultation_private','consultation_ticket_private') OR (n.nspname='public' AND p.proname IN('load_consultation','command_consultation','load_consultation_ticket_inbox','load_consultation_ticket','lookup_consultation_ticket','command_consultation_ticket','prepare_consultation_ticket_attempt','lookup_consultation_ticket_attempt','load_consultation_ticket_attempts')))
ORDER BY kind,object,role) q))::text;
COMMIT;
